content_of_post_to_answer: How do you build better habits and improve yourself?
answer: Building better habits is less about adding discipline and more about redesigning the conditions that shape your behavior. Many people fail because they treat habits as a test of willpower instead of a reflection of their environment, identity, and daily systems. A useful question is not “Why can’t I stay consistent?” but “What makes the wrong action easier than the right one?” Change the defaults, and consistency becomes far less of a struggle.
